To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) bugs in OpenStack are distributed across all components of the system, (2) bugs in Open Stack have a high severity, (3) the bugs are mostly fixed by developers, (4) bugs in Openstack have a low number of fix iterations, and (5) the bugs are fixed by developers in a relatively short period of time.

(1) the most frequently occurring bugs are related to configuration, followed by memory, network and database; (2) bugs in OpenStack are mostly triggered by user input; (3) bugs are often fixed by developers who are not the original developers; (4) bugs can be fixed in one or two days, or can take years to be fixed.

(1) 50% of bugs are related to the user interface; (2) 40% of bugs are fixed by changing the code; (3) 30% of bugs are not fixed; (4) 30% bugs are related to data storage and access; (5) 20% bugs are related with the networking and security.
